messages:
Maria G: Ok team — planning a one-week 'shrinkwrap' sprint starting next Tue to balance critical bugs vs follow-on customer features after the launch. Proposal: reserve ~60% dev capacity for P0/P1 regressions and high-customer-impact fixes, ~40% for small enhancements and measurement spikes. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

ajay: +1 on a short focused sprint. Can we define 'high-customer-impact' as issues affecting >3 customers or core billing/auth flows? Also propose SLAs: P0 -> response within 8h, P1 -> 48h.

taylor: Sounds good. I can run a 30min CS grooming to curate the top 10 reported issues. Would prefer we block 2 hours up-front for triage so we don't keep bouncing tickets.

leo: Agree with the split. One caveat — some feature asks are low-effort/high-value (<= 1 dev day). Recommend a 'fast lane' for those with CS + PM sign-off so we don't lose momentum.

Maria G: Good call @leo. Draft rubric below (for discussion):
```
- Severity: P0 (prod outage/regression), P1 (major feature broken), P2 (minor impact)
- Customer-impact: >3 customers or revenue path -> escalate
- Effort: <=1 dev day -> eligible for fast-lane if PM+CS ok
- Risk: complicated changes (migrations, infra) -> deprioritize for shrinkwrap
```

ajay: Perfect. Owner proposals: @taylor -> triage owner (collect CS list), @leo -> fast-lane reviewer, @Maria G -> sprint release owner. I'll add a 'shrinkwrap' label in Jira and update roadmap ETA.

taylor: I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 11am grooming and drop the curated list to the channel before the meeting. Can we also add a tiny pre-groom checklist: 
- confirm failing repros
- initial impact estimate
- known workarounds

leo: I'll prepare a 3-step smoke test for the top customer flows and run a perf quick-check after fixes land.

Maria G: Great — I'll post the final capacity split and the CS-curated top-10 by EOD tomorrow. If no objections, we'll lock the plan and start backlog tagging. :rocket:
